title: Food business registration or licence (FSSAI)
description: Food businesses must determine whether they need FSSAI registration or a licence before operating; category and eligibility depend on the business activity and current FSSAI criteria.
source_version: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations 2011; Amendment 5 (23 Jun 2026)
source_citation: Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 section 31(1); Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations 2011 regulation 1.1.2.

title: GSTR-3B return (where applicable)
description: Registered persons covered by section 39 and rule 61 must furnish Form GSTR-3B; filing frequency exceptions and due dates depend on the taxpayer category and current notifications.
source_version: Central Goods and Services Tax Rules 2017 rule 61 (CBIC rules compilation reviewed 13 Aug 2026)
source_citation: Central Goods and Services Tax Act 2017 section 39; Central Goods and Services Tax Rules 2017 rule 61(1) Form GSTR-3B.

title: Delhi Shops and Establishments employment requirements
description: For covered Delhi shops and commercial establishments the Labour Department summary identifies working-hour/rest weekly-closure and appointment-letter requirements; exemptions and sector-specific rules must be checked.
source_version: Delhi Shops and Establishments Act 1954; Notification No. F.5/51-1 and L dated 17 Jan 1955 (department page reviewed 13 Aug 2026)
source_citation: Delhi Shops and Establishments Act 1954 sections 8 10 15 16 and 34; commencement notification effective 1 Feb 1955; Delhi Labour Department summary of main provisions.

title: Maharashtra shops and establishments registration or intimation
description: The 2017 Act distinguishes establishments with 10 or more workers from smaller establishments for registration or intimation; the commencement notification and current exemptions must be confirmed before publishing this record.
source_version: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act 2017 (Gazette 07 Sep 2017)
source_citation: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act 2017 sections 1(3)-(4) 6 and 7.
